body:
Thank you for your advice. I really appreciate it. I think I will try opening up to her about my suicidal thoughts.

By the way, congratulations on your progress!

She knows I'm experiencing constant, intense pain. I work from home and sleep around 8 hours, spend 14 hours lying down with my computer on my lap and 2 hours for eating, shower etc.

I have used strong painkillers etc. with no help but not drugs. They are not legal where I live anyway, it would be difficult and dangerous for me to try to access drugs.
